review_findings.description: When both exp and nbf were present, isValid(Instant) evaluated the nbf claim against Instant.now() instead of the caller-supplied Instant. This made historical/future validity checks time-dependent and could incorrectly accept or reject tokens for the requested evaluation time.
The applied PR left DecodedJWT.java malformed, with an import before the package declaration and the getSignature() Javadoc/method split around the new default methods. This broke Java compilation.

blue_fix.fix_explanation: Restored DecodedJWT.java to valid Java source layout with the package declaration first, imports after it, and the original getSignature() method/Javadoc intact before the new defaults. Simplified isValid(Instant) so it validates both exp and nbf consistently against the provided Instant, after preserving the required null check. Existing tests and the provided feature tests pass.
